name: Ising model
description: Lattice statistical mechanics model with binary spins + nearest-neighbor coupling. Foundation for phase transitions + substrate-relevant Hopfield analog at spin level.

name: Topological phase of matter
description: Phases distinguished by topological invariants rather than local order parameters. Foundation for quantum computing analogues + substrate-relevant invariant analysis.

name: Symmetry breaking (spontaneous)
description: Phase where ground state lacks symmetry of Hamiltonian. Foundation for Higgs mechanism + substrate-relevant emergent structure analogues.

name: Soliton + traveling-wave solution
description: Localized non-dispersive wave packet maintaining shape during propagation. Foundation for nonlinear dynamics + substrate-relevant stable-pattern analogues.

name: Bose-Hubbard model
description: Lattice model of bosons with onsite repulsion + hopping. Foundation for quantum phase transitions + substrate-relevant lattice-substrate analogues.

name: Spike-timing-dependent plasticity (STDP)
description: Synaptic plasticity rule where weight changes depend on relative timing of pre/post spikes. Foundation for substrate-relevant temporal learning extension.

name: Place cell (hippocampal)
description: Hippocampal neurons firing selectively at specific spatial locations. Foundation for spatial cognition + substrate-relevant location-binding analogues.

name: Grid cell (entorhinal)
description: Entorhinal cortex neurons firing at vertices of hexagonal lattice in space. Foundation for spatial metric + substrate-relevant manifold-encoding analogues.

name: Cortical column (canonical microcircuit)
description: Vertically-organized cortical unit (~1mm diameter) with stereotyped excitatory + inhibitory connectivity. Foundation for cortical computation models + substrate-relevant modular architecture analogues.

name: Connectome (brain connectivity)
description: Comprehensive map of neural connections in brain. Foundation for connectomics + substrate-relevant graph-structure analysis.

name: Neural population dynamics
description: Collective dynamics of large neuron populations: low-dimensional manifolds + state-space trajectories. Foundation for substrate-relevant population-level state representation.

name: Enzyme kinetics (Michaelis-Menten)
description: v = V_max [S] / (K_M + [S]) saturation kinetics for enzyme-catalyzed reactions. Foundation for biochemistry + substrate-relevant saturating-response analogues.

name: Metabolic pathway (glycolysis / Krebs)
description: Sequence of enzyme-catalyzed reactions: glucose -> pyruvate -> CO2. Foundation for cellular biochemistry + substrate-relevant cascade analogues.

name: DNA replication mechanism
description: Semi-conservative double-helix replication via DNA polymerase + helicase + primase. Foundation for molecular biology + substrate-relevant accurate-copying analogues.

name: Graph neural network (GNN)
description: Neural network operating on graph-structured data via message passing. Foundation for relational learning + substrate-relevant graph operations alternative.

name: Meta-learning (learning to learn)
description: Algorithms learning generalizable learning procedures across tasks: MAML + Reptile + memory-augmented. Foundation for substrate-relevant rapid-adaptation analogues.

name: Continual learning
description: Sequential task learning without catastrophic forgetting. Foundation for substrate-relevant online learning + CLS dual-memory analogues.

name: Transfer learning
description: Learning algorithms applying knowledge from source task to target task. Foundation for substrate-classical mechanism transfer + substrate-relevant capability bootstrapping.

name: Neural architecture search (NAS)
description: Automated search for neural network architectures via RL + evolution + gradient. Foundation for substrate-relevant architecture-self-improvement analogues.

name: Self-supervised learning
description: Learning representations from unlabeled data via pretext tasks: masked prediction + contrastive + autoencoder. Foundation for substrate-relevant weak-supervision analogues.

name: Diffusion model (generative)
description: Generative model via iterative denoising of noise: DDPM + score matching. Foundation for substrate-relevant generative analogues.

name: Complex systems
description: Systems with many interacting components exhibiting emergent properties: self-organization + criticality + scaling. Foundation for substrate-relevant emergent-architecture analogues.

name: Chaos theory
description: Sensitive dependence on initial conditions in deterministic nonlinear systems: Lyapunov exponents + strange attractors. Foundation for substrate-relevant unpredictability analysis.

name: Active matter
description: Out-of-equilibrium systems where constituents convert energy into motion: flocking + cell motility + active gels. Foundation for substrate-relevant self-driven dynamics.

name: Cortical oscillation (alpha + beta + gamma)
description: Rhythmic neural activity across frequency bands: alpha 8-12Hz + beta 13-30Hz + gamma 30-100Hz. Foundation for substrate-relevant phase coupling + theta-gamma binding.

name: Cerebellum (motor coordination + learning)
description: Brain region for motor coordination + supervised motor learning via internal forward models. Foundation for substrate-relevant internal-model analogues per Drill 2 methodology rule magnitude calibration.

name: Basal ganglia (action selection + RL)
description: Brain region for action selection + reinforcement learning via dopamine-modulated cortico-striato-thalamic loops. Foundation for substrate-relevant RL + Bayesian-saliency analogues.

name: Inhibitory neuron (GABAergic)
description: Neurons releasing GABA causing inhibition. Foundation for cortical balance + substrate-relevant negative-weight analogues.

name: Percolation theory
description: Connectivity transitions in random graphs/networks: critical percolation + giant component emergence. Foundation for substrate-relevant connectivity-phase analysis.

name: Renormalization group (RG)
description: Theoretical framework for analyzing physics across scales via scale-invariant fixed points. Foundation for critical phenomena + substrate-relevant multi-scale analysis.
